fato_historico: 1872: Susan B. Anthony and 14 other women are arrested for voting illegally in the United States presidential election of 1872.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic currents invite you to stand firmly in your power, much like those courageous pioneers who once sparked change by demanding their rightful voice. It is a good time to consider how your own bold actions may influence the world around you. Your warmth naturally inspires others, so allow your inner light to shine brightly and authentically.
frase_do_dia: True courage is finding the voice to stand up for what you believe in.
significado_numero: A powerful number reflecting the strength of individual resolve and determination.
conselho: Trust your inner authority and speak your truth with confidence and grace today.
